question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is** "Refridgeration."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Refrigeration."**
 
• The incorrect spelling adds an extra** "d" **after the **"r."**
 
• The correct spelling follows the rule of **"i before e, except after c."**
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "Telepathy,"** refers to the ability to communicate thoughts or ideas without using any known physical or verbal communication methods. ((मौखिक, लिखित या अन्‍य सामान्‍य संप्रेषण विधियों का प्रयोग न करते हुए) व्‍यक्तियों के बीच मानसिक स्‍तर पर संदेशों का आदान-प्रदान; दूर-संवेदन, दूर-बोध, अतींद्रिय बोध, टेलिपैथी)
 
• **Option 3, "Strangulate,"** means to choke or suffocate someone, usually by compressing their neck. (आमतौर पर किसी की गर्दन दबाकर उसका गला घोंटना या दम घोंटना)
 
• **Option 4, "Bewilderment,"** refers to the state of being confused or puzzled. (घबराहट, संभ्रम, हैरानगी)
